draft_en.subject: Switches and media converters for your Timișoara branch - neutral brand
draft_en.body:
Hello Mondo Plast team,

Over the past months you had a few product mails from us - most recently "24 Port PoE Managed Switch" on 18 August 2026 - and there was no reason to answer a mass mail. This one is specific.

Alongside the switches and media converters you import, from small lots, CE/RoHS, neutral packing: 8 x Gigabit PoE+ + 2 x SFP, L2+ managed, Marvell-based - model STC-28DGGPM - $80.7 USD EXW at distributor price (MOQ 1, 15-day validity); budget 8-PoE + 2 uplink unmanaged - STC-028GP - $25.1; industrial mini Gigabit media converter with SFP slot - STI-110GE - $26.5. WDM optics and SFP modules we do not supply.

One question: which band sells most through your Timișoara branch - budget unmanaged PoE, managed PoE, or media converters?

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
